name: Vagrant
source:
A vagrant. He's the leader of a group of homeless men who live in a tent city in town.

[spoiler]As a member of the community he has an equal right to the women of the town. He doesn't want money. He hopes to make Atsuko, Nanako, and any other woman he comes across sex slaves for himself and his gang of vagrants.[/spoiler]
